alt: Cartoon illustration of a woman with dark wavy hair, a grey streak, and black glasses at a gas pump, a pink glow around her. She glares at the pump's ad screen of a soda can while holding the nozzle in a car. Text at the top reads: The gas station used to wash your windshield for free. Now the pump plays commercials at me. An orange box at the bottom reads: While I hand over $50.

Cartoon illustration of a woman with dark wavy hair, a grey streak, and black glasses, shown close up on a red background. She glances aside in exasperation, dangling a long hotel receipt like garbage. Text at the top reads: The hotel charged me a $35 'resort fee.' The resort was a parking lot. A purple box at the bottom reads: And a waffle maker.
